name: Kishore et al carbon utilisation phenotype package
scope: ATLeaf, Biolog, Marine, Populus strain×substrate phenotypes plus genome feature matrices
rights_status: CC BY 4.0 deposit; original upstream phenotype/genome licences independently apply
critical_gap: File-level rights, origin, assay interpretation, accession dedup, exact labels and old splits audit; contains environmental isolates not validated human gut

name: UniProtKB curated experimentally supported annotations
rights_status: Public database described as CC BY 4.0; verify scope and release attribution
critical_gap: Electronic/inferred annotations are NOT experimental ground truth; separate Swiss-Prot evidence codes

name: Rhea curated reactions
scope: Stoichiometric biochemical reactions and links to ChEBI
rights_status: CC BY 4.0 with attribution on official page
critical_gap: Reaction mapping and source version needed; not a growth phenotype label

name: ChEBI chemical identity
critical_gap: Reaction compound ID mapping; no direct microbial outcome labels

name: MGnify
rights_status: Determine dataset-specific rights and upstream depositor terms
critical_gap: MGnify gene/function potential does not establish metabolite output or measured substrate utilization

name: Qiita
rights_status: Study/depositor-specific permissions and controlled access must be audited
critical_gap: Not an automatic source of verified substrate labels; human privacy may apply

name: AGORA2 / Virtual Metabolic Human
rights_status: VERIFY exact model file/repository commercial license before use
critical_gap: Models are hypotheses subject to gaps, not biological truth; solver implementation/license separate

name: MICOM modeling software and compatible models
rights_status: Verify source and bundled model/data licenses separately
critical_gap: No co-culture measured labels in package merely by installing

name: MetaboLights and deposited metabolomics
scope: Assay-specific measured metabolites and sample context
rights_status: Individual study/depositor rights; identity/units/source validation mandatory
critical_gap: Measured human concentrations not identical to bacterial flux

name: Published human intervention datasets
scope: Intervention identity and independently collected measured outcomes
rights_status: Study-specific access, consent, licensing and privacy review
critical_gap: Public trial registries do not necessarily provide analyzable individual-level outcomes
